description:
A channel's live stream opened for a member, where its bytes are served at the
guarded front door, each on a pass for that live stream and that member.

channel.description: The channel, by the identifier the channels list gives it.

direct.description: Where the tuner's own stream is served, carrying its pass.

fingerprint.description:
SHA-256 over the certificate the door presents, lower-case hex, which a client
pins.

lapses.description:
When the passes lapse, in whole seconds since the Unix epoch. A client asks for
new ones before then.

member.description: The member it is opened for, by the name they are known by.

rehearsed.description: Whether this was a rehearsal: what would have happened, with none of it done.

stream.description: The live stream a renewal or a stop names.

transcoded.description: Where a transcoded playlist of it is served, carrying its pass.

unlocated.description: Why nothing is located, where nothing is.
